mapper.sql:
WHERE deleted = 1
AND ( user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR disease LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR job LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND base_score >= 75 AND base_score >= 50 AND base_score < 75 AND base_score < 50
mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, disease, job, base_score AS baseScore, created_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_result
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_result SET deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1

choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analysis_result WHERE deleted = 1 AND created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analysis_result WHERE deleted = 1 AND created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
